title: reveals [dynamic] latches the ambient allocator via append and is never freed (r1 claim still current)
detail: append at :146 passes no allocator (ODN-18 explicit-allocator discipline), latching context.allocator; nothing deletes the buffer — reset only clears length. Empirically confirmed: `odin test app/render` reports `+++ leak 192B @ ... [spawn_fx.odin:146:spawn_fx_feed()]`.
recommended_fix: Wire spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy into the View's creation/teardown (app start/exit + harness Render_Ctx setup) so the buffer owns an explicit allocator and is freed at teardown.

title: spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy are dead code — zero call sites repo-wide (r1 claim still current)
detail: Repo-wide grep finds no callers — app/main.odin:741 and harness/run.odin:293 call only spawn_fx_reset. The intended init/destroy lifecycle never runs; the buffer works solely via append's implicit ambient allocation, which is the root of the leak finding.
recommended_fix: Either call init/destroy at View lifetime boundaries (preferred — also fixes the leak) or delete the dead procs; unreachable lifecycle code invites divergent ownership assumptions.
